ui.theme.label: Theme
ui.metric.cpu.usage.hint: How busy the processor is right now, as a share of its full capacity. It naturally rises during heavy work and should fall back down once that work finishes.
ui.metric.cpu.temp.pkg.hint: The temperature measured by the processor's own sensor. The console raises a concern once it sits in the high 80s for a few minutes, or straight away if it climbs much higher.
ui.metric.mem.available.hint: How much memory is free for programs to use right away, without needing to close anything first.
ui.metric.mem.swap.used.hint: Data the computer has parked on the disk to free up memory. A small amount is normal; a large or growing figure means memory is tight.
ui.metric.battery.charge_pct.hint: The battery's current charge, as a share of a full charge — falling while unplugged, rising while it charges.
ui.metric.load.1.hint: A smoothed recent average of the work being done, waiting for a turn on the processor, or stuck waiting on the disk. A figure around the number of processor cores means the machine is busy but keeping up; if it is high while the processor itself looks idle, a slow or struggling disk is often the reason.

verdict.OK: Your computer is in good shape.
verdict.INFO: Everything works, with one thing worth knowing.
finding.cpu.usage_high.title: Your computer has been working hard for {sustain_minutes} minutes
finding.cpu.usage_high.why: It has been using {usage_pct} % of its processing power for a while now. That is normal during heavy work, but if it lasts for no reason the computer may heat up and slow down.
finding.memory.pressure.title: Memory is nearly full: only {available_bytes} left ({available_pct} % free)
finding.memory.pressure.why: The computer has started moving data to the disk ({swap_used_bytes} so far), which is far slower than memory. Closing a few applications should make it responsive again.
finding.thermal.high.title: Your computer has been running hot for a while ({temperature_c} °C)
finding.thermal.high.why: The heat has lasted several minutes. If this happens often, the fan is probably clogged with dust: cleaning it extends the life of the machine.
finding.thermal.critical.title: Your computer is very hot ({temperature_c} °C)
finding.thermal.critical.why: At this temperature the machine throttles itself to avoid damage and may shut down on its own. Check that the air vents are not blocked and place the device on a hard surface.
finding.battery.wear.title: The battery has lost {wear_pct} % of its original capacity
finding.battery.wear.why: It therefore lasts less time than when new. This is normal battery ageing, but past half its capacity, replacing it becomes reasonable.
finding.battery.incoherent.title: Battery readings cannot be trusted
finding.battery.incoherent.why: This computer reports impossible battery figures, which is a known flaw in some manufacturers' firmware. Rather than show you a wrong number, we show none. The battery itself is probably fine.
